performance.verdict: Paid channels dead 28+ days; only organic GBP signal, now silent too.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across Meta and Google Ads for all 28 days — $0 in, $0 out. No CPL is computable; there is no active paid engine.

GBP actions fell to 0 in the last 7 days (-100% delta) after delivering 30 actions in the prior period; 3-day signal (Sep 6–8) shows 0, 0, 0 vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5) also 0, 0, 0 — full organic stall confirmed.
GA4 sessions dropped 32.2% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 6–8) averaged 4 sessions vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5) averaging 6.3 — directional decay, likely tied to zero paid traffic and GBP falloff.

suggestions.text: Confirm whether paid campaigns are intentionally paused; re-check Sep 12 for any spend resumption.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads recorded $0 spend across every single day in the 28-day window — this is not a data gap, it is a full stop. Before any budget action can be taken, confirm with the client whether campaigns are intentionally paused (e.g. seasonal hold, scope change) or if this is an account issue (billing, policy). Success check: spend > $0 confirmed in platform by 2026-09-12.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP for listing suppression or visibility drop; re-check Sep 12 for any action recovery.
